title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Releases Misalignment Disclosure Framework & 6 Safety Reports: OpenAI details a new public disclosure policy for model misalignment during training and evaluation, publishing six empirical case studies on observed misaligned behaviors.

Nous Research Cleans 1M Lines of Code with 1,393 Hermes Subagents: Technical details reveal how 1,393 Hermes subagents ran over 19 hours to reduce a Python codebase by 34.4%, saving nearly $2M in developer time.

Tencent AI Open Sources BrowserSkill for Local Agent Tab Sharing: Tencent AI releases BrowserSkill, an open-source CLI allowing local AI agents to borrow authenticated browser tabs for seamless web actions and captcha handling.
Warsh Fed Hikes Rates 25bps Ahead of 2026 Midterms: Macro analysts highlight the policy shift under Fed Chair Warsh, implementing a 25bps rate hike with core CPI at 2.4%.

items.title: @OpenAI: OpenAI Publishes Misalignment Framework & 6 Safety Reports
items.body: OpenAI releases a standardized criteria and timeline framework for disclosing model misalignment during training and evaluation, accompanied by six initial empirical reports from the past six months.

items.title: @NousResearch: 1,393 Hermes Subagents Refactor 1M Lines of Code
items.body: Nous Research demonstrates large-scale multi-agent execution: 1,393 Hermes subagents ran across 19 hours to trim a 1,000,000-line Python codebase by 34.4%, saving $2M in human engineering costs.

items.title: @TencentAI_News: Tencent AI Open Sources BrowserSkill for Local Agents
items.body: Tencent AI introduces BrowserSkill, a local CLI bridge that lets AI coding agents borrow active browser tabs with logged-in credentials to handle complex web workflows and interactive captchas.

items.title: @salesforce: Marc Benioff Demonstrates Salesforce in Claude Live Keynote
items.body: Salesforce Chair and CEO Marc Benioff presents AIforce and Salesforce in Claude live on the main stage, showcasing 37 pre-built sales skills directly integrated into Claude workflows.

items.title: @notkevinzhang: Jev Frontier Model Claims 200x Speedup via Parallel RLCD
items.body: Ex-ChatGPT researchers announce Jev, a stealth frontier AI model trained via Reinforcement Learning from Composable Decisions (RLCD) that achieves 20-200x faster decision execution.

items.title: @alexandr_wang: Scale AI Muse Offers 1 Billion Tokens for Friend Referrals
items.body: Scale AI founder Alexandr Wang launches referral invite codes for Muse, rewarding users with up to 1 billion tokens each when inviting up to 20 friends.

items.title: @zerohedge: Warsh Fed Hikes Rates 25bps Ahead of Midterm Elections
items.body: Macro strategists track monetary policy divergence as the Warsh Fed enacts a 25bps rate hike with core CPI at 2.4%, contrasting with 2024 pre-election rate cuts.

items.title: @moomoo: Moomoo Integrates Inline X Cashtag Trading Partnership
items.body: Fintech platform Moomoo officially launches inline X Cashtag integration, enabling users to tap stock tickers on X and execute one-click trades.

items.title: @KeithMcCullough: 24-Year Hedge Fund Process Blueprint Released
items.body: Hedgeye founder Keith McCullough releases a free 52-page guide titled 'Master the Market', detailing quantitative risk management and macro positioning strategies.

items.title: @Phoenixyin13: Manifold Hypothesis & Learning as Compression Breakdown
items.body: An in-depth theoretical analysis explores how deep learning compresses high-dimensional data onto lower-dimensional manifolds, linking Shannon entropy, Kolmogorov complexity, and intelligence.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Jürgen Klopp Excludes Leroy Sané from Germany National Squad
items.body: Germany national team manager Jürgen Klopp decides to omit Leroy Sané from upcoming international match call-ups, according to Bild reports.

items.title: @GUST_EN: Atelier Karia Physical Pre-Orders Launch for Next-Gen Systems
items.body: GUST officially opens physical pre-orders and confirms a February 2027 launch window for Atelier Karia across PS5, Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.
